subject: Next step: demo + trial kickoff (playbook & success criteria)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Benson <claire@mediacorp.ai>
Cc: Sam Ortiz <sam.ortiz@mediacorp.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Hi Claire — great speaking earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposal for next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what you shared
- Primary use: customer support summarization + routing for a subset of enterprise customers (voice -> transcript -> LLM for triage).
- Success metrics: 25% reduction in TTR on tier-1 tickets, >90% NLU accuracy on intent classification, under $0.003/response unit target for production.
- Data constraints: transcripts stored in-house, cannot be sent to third-party S3; encryption-at-rest required.
- Timeline: pilot decision by end of Q4, production GA in H1 2027.

Recommended next step
- 60-min demo + technical deep dive with our Solutions Engineer to align on integration points (phone transcription batching, prefix caching, runtime SLOs).
- 2-week trial plan (sandbox + 3 evaluation prompts sets + one regression check).

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tues Oct 20, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Oct 21, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Oct 22, 09:00–10:00

If any of those work I can send a calendar invite and a short trial playbook (includes success criteria, prompt set examples, and data handling checklist). I’ll bring our SE (Jordan Blake) and CSM (Marissa Cole) to the kickoff.

Quick ask for you before the kickoff:
- Confirm which internal stakeholders should be on the trial (procurement, security, infra).
- Share one redacted sample transcript and one intent taxonomy doc. If you prefer, we can accept those via a secure upload link after NDAs.

Thanks again — excited to push this forward.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: proposed_kickoff_agenda.ics (calendar stub)

From: Claire Benson <claire@mediacorp.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Ortiz <sam.ortiz@mediacorp.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear recap. Wed Oct 21 14:00–15:00 works for us. I’ll invite Anna (Security) and Marco (Platform) to the session.

As for artifacts: I can share a redacted transcript and our intent taxonomy after noon today. Procurement will loop in separately (procurement@mediacorp.ai) if we progress past technical validation.

Two quick clarifications: 
1) When you say "sandbox" for the trial, is that a VPC/private trial or hosted test data environment?
2) Can the playbook include the exact success criteria format you need for our evaluation committee?

See you Wednesday — Claire
Claire Benson
Head of Product, Mediacorp AI
claire@mediacorp.ai | +1 (212) 555-1234

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Benson <claire@mediacorp.ai>
Cc: Sam Ortiz <sam.ortiz@mediacorp.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Perfect — thanks Claire. Confirmed: Wed Oct 21, 14:00–15:00 PDT. Calendar invite attached (proposed_kickoff_agenda.ics).

Answers: 
- Sandbox type: We can run either a hosted sandbox or a VPC/private trial depending on your security preference. For initial evaluation we typically provision a temporarily isolated hosted sandbox with strict retention controls; if you require a private VPC trial we can switch but that will add ~3 business days for provisioning. Please indicate preference during the call.
- Success criteria: yes — the playbook I’m attaching (redwood_trial_playbook_v1.pdf) includes a one-page success criteria template that mirrors what our evaluation committee needs (metrics + pass/fail thresholds + sampling plan).

What Jordan and Marissa will own for the kickoff:
- Jordan: technical deep dive (integration hooks, latency expectations, batching configuration, KV cache approach), initial prompt-set design, and test harness.
- Marissa: trial SLOs, measurement plan, billing/usage reporting cadence, and customer success checkpoints.

Prep items for Wednesday (short list):
1) Share one redacted transcript + intent taxonomy (Claire)
2) Confirm sandbox preference (hosted vs VPC)
3) Provide a primary technical contact for integrations (name/email)

I'll upload the playbook to the secure Drive link and share the HubSpot trial record.

Cheers,
Aditya

Attachments: redwood_trial_playbook_v1.pdf (1 page playbook stub), proposed_kickoff_agenda.ics

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Benson <claire@mediacorp.ai>, Sam Ortiz <sam.ortiz@mediacorp.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Action items before Mediacorp kickoff (Wed 14:00 PDT)

Marissa / Jordan — quick internal note so we come prepared for the Wed kickoff: 

Context in one line: Mediacorp wants a 2-week trial to validate summarization + intent classification on internal transcripts; sensitive data, prefer private hosting. Decision window: pilot commit by end of Q4.

For our side before Wed:
- Jordan: prepare a short deck (3 slides) that outlines integration options (hosted sandbox vs VPC), typical latency/cost tradeoffs, and the prompt-set template we’ll use. Also include an example of our prefix caching and continuous batching behavior for streaming transcripts.
- Marissa: draft the SLO/checklist page for the trial playbook and a one-paragraph description of how we report usage and costs during the pilot. Add a note about retention & deletion policy for redacted samples.
- Both: review the attached playbook and flag any items we need to clarify on the call. I already told Claire we can do hosted sandbox initially but that they might require VPC — if provisioning is needed, we should note the ~72-hour lead time.

Attendees expected from Mediacorp: Claire (Product), Sam (Platform), Anna (Security), Marco (Infra). Procurement may join later.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RDW-2026-1007 
Drive playbook: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/mediacorp-trial-playbook

Thanks — see you both on Wed.

Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
